title: Kicho Hana

note.p: A basic form taught by many schools before Taegeuk Il Jang. It uses one stance (front stance), one block (low block) and one punch (middle punch), so a new student can concentrate on stepping, turning and chambering. The floor line is an I: across the starting line, down the middle, across the far line, back up the middle, and across the starting line again. Basic forms are not set by the Kukkiwon and every school has its own version; this page draws the 20-movement version charted by Taekwondo Preschool.

footer: This is the 20-movement version: the first line (1–4) is walked again at the end (17–20). Some schools stop after 16. The kihaps are on 8 and 16. Finish with Baro: bring the left foot back and turn to face ga in the ready stance, on the spot where you started.

moves.desc: Stand at na facing ga, feet parallel and one foot-width apart, fists in front of the belt.
Turn 90° left toward da¹, stepping the left foot into a left front stance. Left low block.
Step forward into a right front stance. Right middle punch.
Turn 180° right toward ra¹, moving the right foot into a right front stance. Right low block.
Step forward into a left front stance. Left middle punch.
Turn 90° left toward ga, stepping the left foot into a left front stance. Left low block.
Step forward into a right front stance. Right middle punch.
Step forward into a left front stance. Left middle punch.
Step forward into a right front stance. Right middle punch. Kihap.
Turn 270° left toward ra³, moving the left foot into a left front stance. Left low block.
Step forward into a right front stance. Right middle punch.
Turn 180° right toward da³, moving the right foot into a right front stance. Right low block.
Step forward into a left front stance. Left middle punch.
Turn 90° left toward na, stepping the left foot into a left front stance. Left low block.
Step forward into a right front stance. Right middle punch.
Step forward into a left front stance. Left middle punch.
Step forward into a right front stance. Right middle punch. Kihap.
Turn 270° left toward da¹, moving the left foot into a left front stance. Left low block.
Step forward into a right front stance. Right middle punch.
Turn 180° right toward ra¹, moving the right foot into a right front stance. Right low block.
Step forward into a left front stance. Left middle punch.
